purpose: Diagnose misses, freeze multi-pass blocker, compare four GBDT feature contracts without locked test access

taxonomy.text_signals: nonempty-guarded username/fullname same-field and cross-field JaroWinkler, TFIDF cosine and token Jaccard; bio/location same-field JaroWinkler/token Jaccard. No predecessor model score.
taxonomy.link_signal: exact nonempty URL or non-generic normalized domain
taxonomy.e: max defined lexical text signal <0.2 and no link signal; apparent ceiling for these features only, not universally unrecoverable
taxonomy.d: link signal and no text signal>=0.85; no prior e
taxonomy.c: at least one username/fullname absent; no prior e/d
taxonomy.a: username same-field >=0.85 and fullname same-field <0.5; no prior e/d/c

blocking.fit_scope: three development folds excluding evaluated fold; no labels in retrieval
blocking.ranking: rank rounds then deterministic seed42 hash of pass/query/target-platform/pair; deduplicate canonical undirected pairs, prefix exact budget; no raw cosine across passes/queries
blocking.domain_generic_exclusions: reuse rep.GENERIC_DOMAINS; exact nonempty URL keys allowed
blocking.rounding: ceil per-fold baseline candidate count times multiplier
blocking.baseline: original frozen full-profile sparse TFIDF global-budget retrieval using existing fold-specific fitted retrievers
blocking.selection: highest pooled development PC among measured method/budget choices, ties fewer candidates then method name; freeze artifacts before feature comparison

training.parameter_space: reuse original protocol.GBDT, not original final result
training.selection: mean AP over four held development folds, TPE seed42
training.OOF: train on union of three fold-local candidate populations; evaluate fourth; no cross-fold pairs
training.importance: held-fold single-column permutation AP decrease on at most25000 uniformly sampled validation pairs, three repeats, model seed42 only; report mean/SD across folds and repeats; constant columns verified zero contribution without needless inference; correlated features not causal importance
training.candidate_selection_bias: blocker and model selection reuse development; OOF results conditional on this post-hoc selection, not independent nested estimates

frozen_policy.source: original development-only metrics/policy_selection.json best_policy family and artifacts/calibrator.pkl
frozen_policy.calibration_transport_warning: fixed calibrator was learned on original candidate population/features; probability transfer may be poor; AP unaffected by policy
frozen_policy.recall_denominator: all canonical cross-platform development positives, including blocking misses; REVIEW positives not auto-recovered

historical_contract_rule: trace exact source definitions; reimplement label-blind/train-only defects; absent image != unavailable image mapping; block historical41 if safe development-only image linkage cannot be verified
privacy: no profile values, handles, URLs, entity/profile IDs in public reports, logs or worker messages; private arrays remain local
original_gate_status: researcher-declared G0/G1; no references added by this post-hoc run; no confirmatory claims
